full_prompt_en: A square, painterly anime illustration shows a sly, dark-haired young man in a bright red jacket holding a dark pistol at the lower left. The view is close, cropping the upper body near the shoulders and lower edge. His head turns back toward the viewer from a three-quarter angle, with swept black hair, large brown eyes, dark sideburns, a long angular chin, and a crooked smile. One eyebrow arches above the nearer eye, giving the expression playful confidence. Warm light catches the bridge of the nose, cheek, forehead, and ear, while a cooler teal shadow sits under the jaw and around the far side of the face. A blue shirt collar and narrow yellow tie appear between the open lapels of the red jacket. The jacket fills the lower right as a large warm color block, textured by loose visible strokes and small pale scuffs. His hand rises from the lower left gripping a compact dark handgun angled upward, its silhouette clear against the turquoise ground. Behind him, the background is not a detailed room but a rough wash of saturated cyan and yellow, with scattered red specks and brushy patches. These marks radiate around the head, increasing the energy without confusing the simple figure. The style combines clean, expressive character outlines with broad painted color and imperfect grain. Light appears to come from the upper right and front, producing golden highlights on the hair and face and leaving the underside of the gun darker. No readable text appears. The overall composition is bold and jaunty, using a close mischievous face, one diagonal prop, and lively primary-color contrast to create motion within a still image.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形、带绘画感的动画插画呈现一名狡黠的黑发年轻男子穿着亮红外套，左下方握着一把深色手枪。取景贴近，从肩旁和下缘裁切上身。他以四分之三角度回头望向观者，有向后扫的黑发、大褐眼、深色鬓角、长而棱角分明的下巴和歪斜笑容。一侧眉毛在较近的眼上扬起，让神情显得调皮而自信。暖光照亮鼻梁、面颊、额头与耳朵，较冷的青绿阴影留在颌下和脸的远侧。蓝色衬衫衣领与狭窄黄领带从红外套敞开的翻领间露出。外套作为一块大的暖色域填满右下，带松散可见笔触和浅色小擦痕。他的手从左下举起，握住一把斜向上的紧凑深色手枪，其剪影在青绿色底场前清楚。背景不是详细房间，而是饱和青色与黄色的粗糙晕染，散有红色斑点和刷痕。笔痕围绕头部向外扩散，增加活力，却不混淆简洁的人物。风格把干净有表情的人物轮廓与宽阔的绘画颜色、不完美颗粒结合。光似乎来自右前上方，在头发和脸上留下金色高光，枪的下侧更暗。没有可读文字。整体构图醒目而轻快，以贴近的狡黠面孔、一件斜向道具和活泼原色对照，使静止图像带有动势。
style_prompt_en: The painterly anime style combines clean exaggerated character shapes with loose, textured color strokes. Saturated cyan and yellow form an energetic field against a concentrated vermilion mass, while dark navy lines and muted teal shadow keep the focal contours readable. Warm directional highlights make rounded surfaces glow, but rough patches, specks, and imperfect edges prevent polished flatness. A close crop emphasizes one expressive central shape, and a single diagonal accent moves the eye through the lower portion. Broad color areas surround relatively precise features; this difference in finish keeps the image lively without losing clarity. Shadow is selective and colored rather than uniformly black, with bright warm planes meeting cooler recesses. The overall effect is playful, bold, and kinetic, using brush texture to roughen crisp animated design.
style_prompt_zh: 这种带绘画感的动画风格把干净夸张的人物形状与松散有肌理的彩色笔触结合。饱和青色和黄色形成充满能量的底场，对照集中的朱红体量；深海军蓝线条与低饱和青绿影让焦点轮廓清楚。暖色定向高光使圆润表面发亮，粗糙色片、斑点和不完美边缘又避免光洁平坦。贴近裁切强调有表情的中央形体，一道斜向重音引导视线经过下部。宽阔色域围绕相对精确的细节；完成度的差别让画面活泼却不失清晰。阴影有选择性且带颜色，而非均匀黑色，明亮暖平面与较冷凹处相遇。整体效果有玩心、醒目而动感，用笔触肌理粗化清爽的动画设计。
theme_en: A grinning animated detective in a red jacket holding a dark pistol
theme_zh: 身穿红外套、手持深色手枪的咧嘴动画侦探
name: Lupin the Third
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
